description: El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) Indicators is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA National Weather Service, Climate Prediction Center. Find current ENSO conditions and forecasts for the United States with links to historical information, outlooks, and expert discussions and assessments. The current conditions section includes maps and animations for sea surface temperatures, tropical outgoing longwave radiation, and winds. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, High Winds. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
